visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand with white and gold nail art holds a black iPhone 14 Pro, which displays a vibrant video of a girl in a yellow jersey dancing. The camera pans out to reveal a young Asian woman with short black hair, wearing a black crop top and high-waisted blue jeans, dancing energetically in a studio with a green sofa and a wooden desk. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom center. (2) The scene shifts to a vertical screen recording of an iPhone interface. It shows a TikTok-style video of a girl dancing in a neon-lit pink subway station. The user then navigates to the App Store page for 'intoLive' and opens the application, which features a dark mode UI with various icons for creating live wallpapers. A red circle highlights the interactive buttons. (3) The recording demonstrates the editing process within the 'intoLive' app. The user selects a dance video and uses a trimming tool at the bottom to crop a 1.5-second segment. Then, the process moves to the iPhone's lock screen settings, where the user long-presses the background, taps the blue 'plus' icon, and selects the new Live Photo. A red circle emphasizes the 'Live Photo' toggle at the bottom left. (4) A quick montage displays three different examples of dynamic wallpapers: a girl in a furry white hat, a girl in a black uniform, and the original girl in the jersey. The video cuts back to the studio where the girl in blue jeans continues her playful, swaying dance while looking at the camera. The background lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows in the room.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 欸 你這個 iPhone 動態鎖定畫面. (2) [Subtitle]: 怎麼弄的啊!?. [Variety]: OOOOOO. (3) [Subtitle]: 欸 怎麼弄的啦！. (4) [Subtitle]: 你就先準備一段 你喜歡的直式影片. (5) [Subtitle]: 我自己是直接下載別人的短影音啦！. (6) [Logo]: intoLive. [Subtitle]: 然後你去下載 intoLive 這個 App. (7) [Subtitle]: 然後打開 點動態牆紙 然後選你剛剛準備的影片. (8) [Subtitle]: 接著它就會叫你 擷取想設定為動態桌布的片段. (9) [Subtitle]: 動態桌布大概只會 擷取原況照片中間的 1~2 秒. (10) [Subtitle]: 所以你就看一下你想要哪一段 選好之後按右上角的 Done. (11) [Subtitle]: 然後再按右上角的儲存 最後就是設定桌布. (12) [Subtitle]: 拉下來 長按 新增 點照片 點全部. (13) [Subtitle]: 選你剛剛做好的原況照片 然後最重要的！. (14) [Subtitle]: 把左下的動態效果打開 這樣你的鎖定畫面就會動起來囉！. (15) [Subtitle]: 不過有些動作比較大的可能會有點破圖 你選影片的時候自己再看一下啦！. (16) [Subtitle]: 好讚喔！不過只有 2 秒還蠻可惜的. (17) [Subtitle]: 之前教的三星可以 15 秒 是喔！那你下次教我三星的啊. (18) [Subtitle]: 好啊 但你要停下來了嗎？

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach iPhone users how to use the 'intoLive' app to convert standard videos into dynamic Live Photo wallpapers for their lock screens. It combines high-energy social interaction with clear, step-by-step screen recording instructions to appeal to a tech-savvy, lifestyle-oriented audience.
